text:
Note on the diff: the ticket text is vague, but the diff does two things. It adds 198.18.10.0/24 to PL_WAN on border1/border2, which controls what BGP routes are redistributed into OSPF. It also makes wan advertise 198.18.1.0/24 (backed by a null0 static) over BGP. Notably, 198.18.1.0/24 is not in PL_WAN, so it should not be redistributed into the fabric, and 198.18.10.0/24 is permitted but not originated by wan, so it should not appear either. The plan checks that existing WAN reachability is unchanged and that the new prefix does not leak into the fabric.
